text:
anya: quick sync request — need to reconcile launch swimlanes for the Q3 customer-driven private deploy (Acme). Can we do a short decisions thread here before the triage meeting?

sam: yep. what's blocking?

anya: two things: 1) runtime needs a reduced feature set to hit latency SLOs for initial canary, 2) infra needs 48h lead to provision dedicated capacity if we keep full telemetry. both affect scope.

mike: infra note — 48h is optimistic if we require HSM/KMS + private VPC peering. provisioning + security review = closer to 5 business days.

leila: security: if Acme requires HSM-backed keywrap and yearly audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, we need tenancy-specific policies and an initial compliance checklist. 5 days + 2-day audit window (light).

diego: runtime: the big perf hit is streaming + function-calling + tracing enabled. If we disable structured tracing for canary and use token-sampled traces, we can meet 99th p95 latency target with current instance class. that reduces infra telemetry load.

anya: proposal: ship canary with reduced telemetry (token-sampled traces, metrics only in console) + no function-calls on first 2k requests, then enable features post-canary. Is that acceptable? @sam @mike

sam: acceptable from runtime side — we'll gate function-calling by feature flag and set default off for Acme canary. Need a prompt/contract change though (inform product).

mike: infra can do 48h for basic VPC peering + reserved GPUs if we accept no HSM in canary. If HSM required we need the 5 days. So scope decision toggles infra lead time.

leila: security: HSM can be deferred for canary with caveat: key lifecycle management must be documented and roll plan in place. Acme legal ok'd a phased KMS plan earlier? @anya

anya: yes legal signed phased KMS in principle, but client PM asked for HSM in pilot. I'll confirm. If they accept phased approach we can go faster.

sarah: design note — if we plan to disable function-calls, UX must show a thin error state for the first week to set expectations. I can mock a fallback banner + link to disclaimers.

oliver: timeline check — triage meeting is tomorrow 11am. We need a one-sentence decision on scope and an owner for rollout playbook.

anya: decision for meeting prep: 1) canary scope = runtime core generation + embeddings + token-sampled tracing; no function-calling; 2) infra scope = reserved capacity without HSM; parallel path to enable HSM in 5 business days; 3) security owner = @leila, infra owner = @mike, runtime owner = @sam, product owner = @anya.

sam: noted. I'll prepare a fallback policy: if p95 > 400ms for 5m window, route traffic to hosted tier and flag call.

mike: infra will draft capacity request doc. Quick config snippet for prod slot we plan to reserve:

```yaml
pool: acme-private-pool
nodes: 4
gpu: a100-40gb
burst: 2
telemetry: metrics-only
hsm: false # canary

```

oliver: can you add expected cost delta estimate? finance will ask.

mike: roughly +$9k/mo for reserved pool baseline, burst adds variable. I'll send a calc.

leila: security will publish the phased KMS playbook and the audit checklist by EOD today. We'll flag any must-stop items.

anya: Acme PM reply: "phased KMS is fine, but HSM must be live before GA. canary can proceed without it" — forwarded.

diego: runtime follow-ups: need a minimal test prompt set for quality gating (5 prompts per major intent). Also need to confirm KV cache warm policy.

sarah: I'll author the initial 5 prompts with UX context.

sam: runtime will add cache-warm policy: prewarm top-10 prefixes observed in prod staging for 2h prior to canary.

oliver: owners please confirm you can deliver playbook sections by EOD today so we can lock decisions in the meeting.

mike: will do — infra doc in PR in ~6h.

leila: security doc in progress, will link.

sam: runtime checks in 4h.

anya: thanks. small decision for rollout flags: we will default to manual ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days) and require green quality gate at 50%. If quality gate fails, rollback to 0% and open incident channel. agreed?

diego: agree. need automated eval hook at 50% to run prompt set and compare metrics.

sam: will add automated hook to run evals and emit trace tags.

oliver: I'll update the triage doc and include rollback playbook + contact list.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create release candidate branch and add canary flags before merging.

anya: final ask — if any of you foresee blockers to the decision items above, call out now. otherwise I'll present this as the recommended alignment at tomorrow's triage.

mike: no blockers from infra given phased HSM.

leila: nothing blocking from security with phased approach.

sam: runtime can meet it. one caveat: function-calling backlog items (sandboxing) still open but irrelevant for canary.

anya: great — locking this. I'll add owners + artifacts to the meeting notes and run the triage slot tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
